opportunities_amounts_ordered.name: opportunities_amounts_ordered

opportunities_budget_consistent.name: opportunities_budget_consistent
opportunities_budget_consistent.value:
("opportunities"."budget_type" IS NOT NULL OR ("opportunities"."amount_min" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."amount_max" IS NULL))
        AND (("opportunities"."amount_min" IS NULL AND "opportunities"."amount_max" IS NULL)
          OR ("opportunities"."budget_type" IS NOT NULL AND "opportunities"."currency" IS NOT NULL))

CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("opportunities"."required_skills") = 'array'
    THEN NOT jsonb_path_exists("opportunities"."required_skills", 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() != "string")')
    ELSE false
  END
